## Description

Extends gradient boosting decision trees to infinite-dimensional function spaces using Neural Operators, evaluating continuous functional feature splits to predict cross-sectional stock returns.

## Where it may fit

Broad cross-sectional equity universes (S&P 500 / Russell 3000), continuous-time factor modeling.

## Vehicles

Quantitative Equity Hedge Funds, Systematic Factor Investing Desks.

## Required data

Multivariate functional factor curves, daily stock return panels, fundamental financial statement series.

## Caveats

Functional tree splitting criteria require high-resolution discretization of input curves.
